svg.title: AI FinOps
svg.desc: A glass coin stack with a dollar sign on a glass cloud: model tiles queue into a slot in the stack, the stack opens, and each model comes out on its own lane to data, time and health readings, so every model's cost is kept apart; then the stack closes.
